lens: Portfolio contention, governance/change-control route, RAID, contract-variation routing.
rules_summary: Any PRINCE2/MSP tolerance breach beyond 2x the delegated tolerance => No (needs a re-baseline, not a change request).
A tolerance breach within 2x, or any contract variation, => Conditional (proceed via the named gate).
No tolerance breach and not a contract variation => Yes.
